name: aoe2mc.age_up
text: Matey %s sails on to the %s, arr!

name: aoe2mc.battle_royale.start
text: Battle Royale: the Corruption takes the map from its shore to its heart in %s. It sinks every crew and hold in it, arr!

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_build
text: I cannot raise a %s there now, matey.

name: aoe2mc.bot.cannot_train
text: I cannot train that crew: I have no hold for it, arr.

name: aoe2mc.bot.flare_two
text: Light two flares for the wall, arr.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_flare
text: I see no flare on the horizon.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_market
text: I have no market: I cannot send tribute, arr.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_wall_resources
text: I have not enough booty for a wall.

name: aoe2mc.bot.no_water
text: I have no water near my town: I cannot build a navy, arr.

name: aoe2mc.bot.onager_no_trees
text: My onagers cannot cut trees, matey.

name: aoe2mc.build.cost
text: Not enough booty: a %s costs %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.build.flat
text: The %s must stand on flat ground, matey.

name: aoe2mc.build.gate_spot
text: A %s must go on 4 tiles of an own wall in a straight line, or on 3 diagonal tiles, arr.

name: aoe2mc.build.shore
text: A %s must stand on water next to the shore, arr.

name: aoe2mc.build.space
text: No room for the %s here, matey.

name: aoe2mc.build.tiles_cost
text: Not enough booty: %s tiles of %s cost %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.build.wall_end
text: %s: right click the end of the wall, matey.

name: aoe2mc.build.water
text: A %s must stand on the water, arr.

name: aoe2mc.camera.fov
text: The fast camera makes the held item swing, arr. To keep it still, set Options > Accessibility Settings > View Bobbing to OFF. The camera also makes the view wider, which shows more of the sea. To keep the normal view, set Options > Accessibility Settings > FOV Effects to 0 %, matey.

name: aoe2mc.camera.on
text: Spyglass: on, speed x%s, arr. Shift right click: next speed.

name: aoe2mc.challenge.battle-formations
text: Sink all enemy crews and lose few of your own, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.booming
text: Train 100 deckhands and sail into the Imperial Age, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.defending-against-a-rush
text: Sail into the Castle Age and survive the enemy raids, matey

name: aoe2mc.challenge.early-economy
text: Gather 200 food, 200 wood, 100 gold and 200 stone, train 21 deckhands, build a lumber camp and a mill, and sail into the Feudal Age, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.fast-castle-age
text: Train 27 deckhands, build 5 houses and sail into the Castle Age, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.land-battle
text: Sink all six enemy waves, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_bronze
text: %s crew lost, bronze medal up to %s, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_gold
text: %s crew lost, gold medal up to %s, arr

name: aoe2mc.challenge.lost_silver
text: %s crew lost, silver medal up to %s, arr

name: aoe2mc.cheat.sharing
text: Sharing is caring, matey: your gold goes to your allies

name: aoe2mc.cheat.wonders
text: You command the sea and land: %s beasts, arr

name: aoe2mc.conquest.allies_end
text: Only allies are left, arr: the alliances end. The last pirate afloat wins.

name: aoe2mc.controls.attack
text: Attack: select your fighting crews, then right click an enemy, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.build
text: Build: select deckhands, right click them for the build menu, select a building, then left click the ground, arr. Shift + left click: place more. Right click: cancel.

name: aoe2mc.controls.camera
text: Camera: right click with the spyglass Camera (hotbar key 2): you walk fast high above the map, arr. Shift right click: the next speed. Right click again: you fly down.

name: aoe2mc.controls.garrison
text: Garrison: select crews, then right click your own hold, arr. Its menu lets them out. Town center menu: Ring Town Bell.

name: aoe2mc.controls.gather
text: Gather: select deckhands, then right click a tree, a berry bush, a mine or a farm, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.goto
text: Go to: right click with the compass Go to (hotbar key 3): a menu of your town centers, your control groups and the next idle deckhand, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.groups
text: Control groups: select crews, take a group item (hotbar keys 5 to 9) and Shift + right click to save the selection, arr. Right click: select the group.

name: aoe2mc.controls.head
text: Controls (hold the carrot on a stick, matey; the action bar shows the next step):

name: aoe2mc.controls.menu
text: Game menu: right click with the book Game menu (hotbar key 4), arr: diplomacy and tribute, flare, save, pause and the tech tree.

name: aoe2mc.controls.move
text: Move: with a selection, right click the ground, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.research
text: Research and age up: right click your own building and click a technology or the next age in its menu, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.select
text: Select: left click a crew. Hold left click and look across the ground: a selection box. Right click: give orders, arr.

name: aoe2mc.controls.train
text: Train: right click your own building (town center, barracks ...) and click a crew in its menu, arr.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.changed
text: Player %s changed its stance to you: %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.diplomacy.speed
text: Player %s set the game speed to %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.follow.refuse_follow
text: Follow: click one of your crews, matey

name: aoe2mc.follow.refuse_guard
text: Guard: click one of your crews or holds, arr

name: aoe2mc.garrison.all_back
text: All hands back to work, arr

name: aoe2mc.garrison.bell_seek
text: The town bell rings, arr: %s deckhands seek shelter

name: aoe2mc.gather.act_select_type
text: select all of the type, arr

name: aoe2mc.gather.corner
text: Selection box: click the other corner, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_ground
text: Attack Ground: right click the ground, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.attack_move
text: Attack Move: right click the ground, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.building
text: Place the %s: right click the ground · Shift + right click: place more · Cancel: /trigger aoe_build set 0, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.building_paper
text: %s: left click to place · Shift: place more · Right click: cancel, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.corner
text: Selection box: right click the other corner, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.follow
text: Follow: right click one of your or allied crews, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.guard
text: Guard: right click one of your or allied crews or holds, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.military
text: %s · Right click: attack an enemy, stance menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.hints.none
text: Left click: select a crew · Hold left click: selection box, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.none_wand
text: Right click: select a crew · Wand: selection box, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.patrol
text: Patrol: right click the ground, arr

name: aoe2mc.hints.villagers
text: %s · Right click: gather, build, build menu · %s

name: aoe2mc.recap.next
text: The game is over, arr. Right click the Recap book in your hand to see the plunder. Stop the game program with Ctrl-C in its console, matey.

name: aoe2mc.relic_victory.all
text: Player %s holds all the relics, arr.

name: aoe2mc.repair.no_resources
text: Not enough booty to repair the %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.hill_won
text: %s held the monument: King of the Hill victory at %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.join_help
text: Double-tap Shift: spectator view (fly through blocks). Right click the hotbar items: replay control, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.king_died
text: : the King died at %s. Regicide: the player is out, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.live_jump
text: Live replay: the jump stops at the delay behind the game, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.no_camera
text: This record has no spyglass of its player, matey.

name: aoe2mc.replay.relic_won
text: takes the relic to a monastery and wins, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.restart_jump
text: The server restarts for the jump back: join it again, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_economy
text: : deckhands trained %s, booty gathered %s, idle deckhand time %s, idle town center time %s, arr

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_hill_holds
text: : holds the monument (King of the Hill), arr

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_hill_won
text: : monument won %s (King of the Hill), arr

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_military
text: : fighting crews trained %s, crews lost %s, holds lost %s, APM %s%s, arr

name: aoe2mc.replay.sum_relic
text: : wins, relic in a monastery %s (Capture the Relic), arr

name: aoe2mc.replay.town_fell
text: : the town center fell at %s. Sudden Death: the player is out, arr.

name: aoe2mc.replay_input.help
text: Replay, arr: right click the items in your hotbar, or click:

name: aoe2mc.run.chat_hint
text: Chat: a normal line goes to all, /tm TEXT to your allies, /msg NAME TEXT to one pirate, arr.

name: aoe2mc.run.left_bot
text: %s left the ship, arr: a bot sails for player %s

name: aoe2mc.run.scenario_starts
text: Scenario %s sets sail, arr. Join again, matey.

name: aoe2mc.run.starts_in
text: The game sets sail in %s, arr

name: aoe2mc.run.wait_ready
text: Open "Choose your pirate" and click "Ready", arr

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first
text: First step, matey: hold the command stick and right click one of your deckhands.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_first_paper
text: First step, matey: hold the command stick and left click one of your deckhands.

name: aoe2mc.run.welcome_goal
text: Goal: win the game, arr. Victory setting: %s.

name: aoe2mc.stance.no_ground
text: No crew can attack the ground, matey

name: aoe2mc.train.rally
text: Right click the ground for the rally point, arr.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.ended
text: The treaty ended, arr: pirates can attack now.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.refuse
text: Treaty: you cannot attack before %s, matey.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.refuse_endless
text: Treaty: you cannot attack in this game, matey.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start
text: Treaty: no pirate can attack another pirate before %s, arr.

name: aoe2mc.treaty.start_endless
text: Treaty: no pirate can attack another pirate in this game, arr.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.barracks
text: Build a barracks, arr: right click on a selected deckhand, choose the barracks and place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells you where to place it, matey.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camera
text: Move fast over the map, arr: right click with the "Camera" item, walk, then right click with it again.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camp
text: Sink the enemy camp in the middle of the map, arr: select your Militia and right click on a building. The boss bar at the top shows the step.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.camps
text: Build a lumber camp near the trees and a mill near the berries, arr. The sidebar on the right shows the wood they cost.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.complete
text: The tutorial is complete, arr. Next: sail against the bot: python3 game/run.py OUTWorld --play --bot

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.feudal
text: Sail into the Feudal Age, arr: right click on your town center and choose the Feudal Age. The sidebar on the right shows your food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.food
text: Gather 100 food, arr: send a deckhand to the berries. The sidebar on the right shows your food.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.house
text: Build a house, arr: right click on a selected deckhand, choose the house and place it. The action bar above the hotbar tells you where to place it, matey.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.militia
text: Train 3 Militia, arr: right click on your barracks and choose the militia. The sidebar on the right shows your food and gold.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.raid
text: The enemy attacks your deckhands, arr! Click the red alert line in the chat to go there, then select your Militia and right click on the enemies. The boss bar at the top shows the health of the selected crew.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.select
text: Select a deckhand, arr: left click on one of your deckhands with the command stick. The boss bar at the top shows the selected crew, the action bar above the hotbar shows the next action.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_barracks
text: TIP, arr: the barracks trains infantry. Infantry is cheap and good against buildings.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camp
text: TIP, arr: attack with all your crews together. A small group sinks before it can do damage.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_camps
text: TIP, arr: build the drop-off buildings near the booty, so that the deckhands walk a short way.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_feudal
text: TIP, arr: the next age unlocks new buildings, crews and technologies. Keep the deckhands at work while you sail on.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_food
text: TIP, arr: berries near a mill are a safe start of food. Later, farms give food that does not end.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_house
text: TIP, arr: a house gives room for 5 more crew. Look at the population in the sidebar and build houses before it is full.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_militia
text: TIP, arr: you can queue up to 15 crews in a building when you have the booty.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_raid
text: TIP, arr: in AoE2 the town bell sends the deckhands into the town center. Ring it when the enemy raids your town.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_select
text: TIP, arr: the Idle line of the sidebar on the right counts your deckhands with no work. Give them work.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_villager
text: TIP, arr: train deckhands all the time in the first ages. More deckhands give more booty.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.tip_wood
text: TIP, arr: deckhands gather faster near a drop-off building. Build a lumber camp next to the trees.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.villager
text: Train a deckhand, arr: right click on your town center and choose the deckhand. The sidebar on the right shows the food it costs.

name: aoe2mc.tutorial.wood
text: Gather 50 wood, arr: select a deckhand and right click on a tree. The sidebar on the right shows your wood.

name: aoe2mc.wonder.destroyed
text: The wonder of player %s is sunk, arr.
